description:
Overwrites the fields you pass; previous values are not kept and cannot be restored from the API, so confirm changes to the prompt, name or settings with the user first. Update a saved AI agent (PUT /v2/agents/:agentId). All fields are optional — only what you pass is updated. Common uses: tune the system `prompt` after a test run, switch `responseMode` to control turn-taking in multi-agent rooms, or adjust `cooldownSec`. See `ethora-agents-quickstart` prompt for the end-to-end recipe.
Requires: an agent id or address from `ethora-agent-list` or `ethora-agent-create`.

agentId.description: Mongo _id (24 hex chars) of the agent to update.

agentIdOrAddress.description: Alias for `agentId` - either name is accepted, pass whichever you have.

cooldownSec.description: Minimum seconds between this agent's replies in a given room. Damped 2x for bot-to-bot. Set 0 for quick turn-taking.

flowsYaml.description: Deterministic scripted conversation for this agent, as YAML. Drives the agent through a fixed sequence (opening menu, appointment request, intake questionnaire, survey) instead of leaving every turn to the model. Compiled and validated server-side on save: an invalid script is rejected with code `FLOWS_INVALID` and per-line details, and nothing is stored. A flow named `start` is reserved and fires when a conversation opens. Buttons are authored here (`buttons:` on a `say` step, or `options:` on an `ask` step). Call `fetch` with id `doc:agent-flows` for the full authoring format before writing one. Pass an empty string to clear the script.

greetingMessage.description: Message the agent posts when it first joins a new room.

name.description: New display name. For multi-agent scenarios prefer single-word names — the @-mention matcher uses exact display-name match with word-boundary.

prompt.description: Updated system prompt (persona + behaviour). For multi-agent rooms instruct the agent to end every message with an @-mention of the next speaker — that's how turn-handoff works through the response gate.

responseMode.description: When the agent replies. 'always' = every message; 'mentioned' = only @-mention or /bot (best for multi-agent turn-taking); 'smart' = mini-LLM decides; 'probability' = coin-flip using `responseProbability`.

responseProbability.description: If responseMode='probability', odds (0-1) of replying. Damped 0.6x for bot-to-bot.

name: ethora-agent-update
title: Update Agent
